Equipment upgrades

Each upgrade improves attack and defence. It costs money and supplies; AA missiles must be bought separately.

Build structures · expensive

Choose a structure, then place it inside your own country. Air bases and ports add aircraft and naval deployment sites; radar reveals nearby enemies; SAM sites can intercept incoming raids; logistics hubs add military supplies; power plants raise income.
